description: Frozen recipe for hp_noise001. Nothing is optimised at training time: with all kernel parameters fixed, training is one Cholesky solve. This file, the pinned dataset and the pinned environment regenerate hp_noise001/model.pkl.

kernel.type: BlockARD(Matern-5/2, ARD, 3 blocks) + global interaction + WhiteKernel
kernel.training_rule: alpha = solve(K + (noise + jitter) * I, (y - loc) / scale), K = block_ard_cov(X_train, X_train)

dataset.notes: Do not re-split or reorder the rows: the byte content and row order are part of the recipe.

environment.note: Repository online environment (pyproject.toml). The original offline fit ran under Python 3.13.5 / numpy 2.1.3 / scipy 1.15.3 / scikit-learn 1.6.1 (see hp_noise001/meta.json); the committed pickle is re-serialised for numpy 1.x.

determinism.note: No RNG is used by training. The seed only records the offline multi-start search.
